NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN PURSUANT TO SECTION 104 of the Public Officers Law that a meeting of the New York City Rent Guidelines Board (RGB) will be held on Thursday, May 21, 2026 at 9:30 AM at Spector Hall, 22 Reade Street, New York, NY 10007.  The Board will be meeting to discuss the 2026 Housing Supply Report and Changes to the Rent Stabilized Housing Stock in NYC in 2025.
